units.source_text: “然而，当我看到秀男织好的腰带，就觉得这不是和我扔掉的画稿一样吗？

en.t: However, when I saw the sash Hideo had woven, I thought, isn't this the same as the design sketch I threw away?

units.source_text: 虽然在颜料和彩线方面，色泽有点不同。”

en.t: Though in terms of the paints and colored threads, the shades were a little different.
